name: True USB Write Progress+
description:
A top-bar widget that monitors real-time pending background writes to removable USB storage, showing true dirty-cache flush progress so you know exactly when a drive is safe to eject. This fork adds target file size detection and shows a real percentage/progress bar when possible, in addition to the original MB/rate display.

Fork of true-usb-progress by Ashen Chathuranga (ktauchathuranga).
